title: Dimension one generalization in locally principal support
statement: For a locally Noetherian scheme Y, a locally principal quasi-coherent ideal J, and a point y in the closed support V(J) with positive Krull dimension of its stalk, there exists a generalization y′ of y still in V(J) whose stalk has Krull dimension one.

source.place: Tag 0BJG, Lemma 58.21.1, applied to the stalk at y

proof.text:
Choose an affine neighbourhood where J is generated by one section d.
Localize its coordinate ring at y. The generator lies in the maximal ideal,
since y belongs to the support. Apply 0BJG to this Noetherian local ring of
positive dimension. Its proof is induction on dimension: in dimension one the
maximal ideal works; in larger dimension choose a component of dimension greater
than one. Its intersection with V(d) has positive dimension by the principal
ideal theorem. A closed point of that intersection in the punctured spectrum
has strictly smaller positive local dimension. Apply induction there and contract
the resulting prime. The prime obtained from 0BJG corresponds to a generalization
y' of y, contains d, and its localization has dimension one. Localization
transitivity identifies that ring with the scheme stalk at y'. The argument
allows d=0 and reducible or nonreduced schemes; dimension zero is excluded.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_dimension_one_generalization_in_locallyPrincipal_support
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J.IsLocallyPrincipal) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ J.support)
    (hpos : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) < ringKrullDim (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) :
    ∃ y' : Y, Specializes y' y ∧ y' ∈ J.support ∧
      ringKrullDim (Y.presheaf.stalk y') = 1
